title: sprint-config is parsed by two YAML loaders: hooks use CSafeLoader (v0.223.0), init/refresh/scan/brief_lint/schema/eval still yaml.safe_load
detail: hook-hot-path (2026-10-25) switched phases.load_sprint_config to libyaml's CSafeLoader (identical results on 112 real YAML files + 13 edge probes). Other sprint-config readers stay on yaml.safe_load (refresh_merge uses ruamel). The two scanners differ only on rare malformed input, so a hook and doctor could disagree about the same malformed file. One fact, two parsers — the reviewer's advisory. Suggest: route every sprint-config read through phases.load_sprint_config (or one shared loader helper) and moat-test that no module calls yaml.safe_load on sprint-config.yaml directly.
